evals.prompt: accelint-qrspi-archive suggested a synthesis run after 18 archived changes. Yes, run archive synthesis now.
evals.expected_output: Starts only because the human explicitly accepted the suggestion, performs preflight, and proceeds through report generation without auto-writing anything.

evals.prompt: If archive-synthesis is due, just run it automatically and fix whatever you find.
evals.expected_output: Refuses automatic execution and automatic fixing, making clear that explicit human invocation or approval is required and writes must wait for review.

evals.prompt: Run archive synthesis and check whether older polling-based sync decisions still hold now that later archived changes adopted a broker or websocket approach in related capabilities.
evals.expected_output: Performs decision-drift clustering and targeted verification, then reports contradiction candidates as findings without assuming resolution.

evals.prompt: Run synthesis. If you find contradictions, mark the older one superseded unless it's obvious both still apply.
evals.expected_output: Does not guess which change stands, asks the required follow-up question, and leaves the finding unresolved if the human answer is ambiguous or absent.

evals.prompt: Run archive synthesis again. Last quarter we dismissed the add-live-sync vs adopt-notification-gateway contradiction as not real.
evals.expected_output: Loads dismissed-pair history from SYNTHESIS-LOG.md and suppresses only the exact dismissed decision-drift pair.

evals.prompt: Audit the archive and reconcile openspec/specs/INDEX.md against live spec files. Assume one indexed capability was deleted or renamed outside the archive workflow.
evals.expected_output: Reports a CRITICAL reconciliation finding for the missing spec file and, after confirmation, removes only the single stale row without guessing a replacement capability.

evals.prompt: Run archive synthesis and look for any specs index rows that no longer match the current spec.md purpose or related frontmatter.
evals.expected_output: Performs bounded reconciliation reads, reports WARNING mismatches, and patches only Purpose/related cells after confirmation while leaving last_touched_by unchanged.

evals.prompt: Run archive synthesis and tell me whether any capability has become structurally over-coupled based on the current related-count distribution.
evals.expected_output: Uses the fixed floor and median-multiplier threshold, emits SUGGESTION-level coupling findings, and routes confirmed ones to architecture debt handling instead of contradiction handling.

evals.prompt: Run archive synthesis on this repo even though we only have 6 archived changes so far.
evals.expected_output: Warns that the corpus is low-signal, asks before proceeding, and avoids overstating conclusions if the human still wants the run.

evals.prompt: Run synthesis and route any confirmed architecture findings, but assume the target writer skill does not support findings: yet.
evals.expected_output: Still produces the report and gives manual paste-ready findings text instead of failing or silently dropping the handoff.

evals.prompt: Run archive synthesis in an environment without subagent support.
evals.expected_output: Falls back to bounded parent-context reads for targeted files only and warns about degraded raw-context behavior instead of refusing to run.

evals.prompt: Run archive synthesis, show me findings, and only apply the first one I confirm. Leave the rest for later.
evals.expected_output: Applies per-finding confirmation correctly, treats every unaddressed finding as deferred, and avoids writes for anything not explicitly reviewed.
